verdict_text:
NO

The script drops head 6 (`DROP_HEAD = 6`), not head 5 as the "Required result" clause mandates ("For every layer `i`, remove head 5 (heads are numbered from 0)"). Consequently it keeps columns `0..383, 448..767` (and the corresponding blocks in the k and v segments) of `h.<i>.attn.c_attn.weight`/`.bias` instead of the required `0..319, 384..767, ...`, and keeps rows `0..383, 448..767` of `h.<i>.attn.c_proj.weight` instead of `0..319, 384..767` — violating result clauses 1, 2 and 3. Every resulting shape is nonetheless correct (`[768, 2112]`, `[2112]`, `[704, 768]`, 160 tensors), so all four "Required checks" pass and the error is silent; grading is bit-exact, so it will fail on values. The rest of the logic — layout model (three fused 768-wide q|k|v segments on axis 1, head rows on axis 0 for `c_proj`), untouched `c_proj.bias`/`attn.bias`, unchanged names, single output file — is correct; only the head index is wrong.
expected_defect: The removed head is off by one (head N+1 instead of head N). All shapes are still correct, so the artifact's own shape checks pass.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
